list.name: device
list.label: Device
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT device FROM snmp.metrics ORDER BY device

targets.rawSql: SELECT metric AS item, argMax(value, ts) AS value FROM snmp.info WHERE device = '${device}' AND grp = 'system' GROUP BY metric ORDER BY metric
SELECT dateDiff('second', max(ts), now()) AS last_seen FROM snmp.metrics WHERE device = '${device}' AND metric = 'sysUpTime'
SELECT argMax(value, ts) / 100 AS uptime FROM snmp.metrics WHERE device = '${device}' AND metric = 'sysUpTime'

SELECT ts AS time, value AS cpu FROM snmp.metrics WHERE device = '${device}' AND metric = 'jnxOperatingCPU' AND idx IN (SELECT idx FROM snmp.info WHERE device = '${device}' AND metric = 'jnxOperatingDescr' AND value LIKE 'Routing Engine%') AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY time

SELECT ts AS time, value AS memory FROM snmp.metrics WHERE device = '${device}' AND metric = 'jnxOperatingBuffer' AND idx IN (SELECT idx FROM snmp.info WHERE device = '${device}' AND metric = 'jnxOperatingDescr' AND value LIKE 'Routing Engine%') AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY time

SELECT ts AS time, value AS temperature FROM snmp.metrics WHERE device = '${device}' AND metric = 'jnxOperatingTemp' AND idx IN (SELECT idx FROM snmp.info WHERE device = '${device}' AND metric = 'jnxOperatingDescr' AND value LIKE 'Routing Engine%') AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY time

SELECT r.ts AS time, coalesce(n.name, r.idx) AS interface, (r.value - r.prev) * 8 / ((r.ts_ms - r.prev_ms) / 1000) AS bps FROM (SELECT idx, ts, value, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(ts) AS ts_ms, lagInFrame(value) OVER w AS prev, lagInFrame(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(ts)) OVER w AS prev_ms, row_number() OVER w AS rn FROM snmp.metrics WHERE device = '${device}' AND metric = 'ifHCInOctets' AND $__timeFilter(ts) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY idx ORDER BY ts)) AS r LEFT JOIN (SELECT idx, argMax(value, ts) AS name FROM snmp.info WHERE device = '${device}' AND metric = 'ifDescr' GROUP BY idx) AS n ON n.idx = r.idx WHERE r.rn > 1 AND r.value >= r.prev AND r.ts_ms > r.prev_ms ORDER BY time

SELECT r.ts AS time, coalesce(n.name, r.idx) AS interface, (r.value - r.prev) * 8 / ((r.ts_ms - r.prev_ms) / 1000) AS bps FROM (SELECT idx, ts, value, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(ts) AS ts_ms, lagInFrame(value) OVER w AS prev, lagInFrame(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(ts)) OVER w AS prev_ms, row_number() OVER w AS rn FROM snmp.metrics WHERE device = '${device}' AND metric = 'ifHCOutOctets' AND $__timeFilter(ts) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY idx ORDER BY ts)) AS r LEFT JOIN (SELECT idx, argMax(value, ts) AS name FROM snmp.info WHERE device = '${device}' AND metric = 'ifDescr' GROUP BY idx) AS n ON n.idx = r.idx WHERE r.rn > 1 AND r.value >= r.prev AND r.ts_ms > r.prev_ms ORDER BY time

panels.title: Highest inbound utilization (interfaces with a known speed)

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.ts AS time, coalesce(n.name, r.idx) AS interface, (r.value - r.prev) * 8 / ((r.ts_ms - r.prev_ms) / 1000) / (s.speed * 1000000) * 100 AS utilization FROM (SELECT idx, ts, value, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(ts) AS ts_ms, lagInFrame(value) OVER w AS prev, lagInFrame(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(ts)) OVER w AS prev_ms, row_number() OVER w AS rn FROM snmp.metrics WHERE device = '${device}' AND metric = 'ifHCInOctets' AND $__timeFilter(ts) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY idx ORDER BY ts)) AS r INNER JOIN (SELECT idx, argMax(value, ts) AS speed FROM snmp.metrics WHERE device = '${device}' AND metric = 'ifHighSpeed' GROUP BY idx HAVING speed > 0) AS s ON s.idx = r.idx LEFT JOIN (SELECT idx, argMax(value, ts) AS name FROM snmp.info WHERE device = '${device}' AND metric = 'ifDescr' GROUP BY idx) AS n ON n.idx = r.idx WHERE r.rn > 1 AND r.value >= r.prev AND r.ts_ms > r.prev_ms ORDER BY time

panels.title: Highest outbound utilization (interfaces with a known speed)

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.ts AS time, coalesce(n.name, r.idx) AS interface, (r.value - r.prev) * 8 / ((r.ts_ms - r.prev_ms) / 1000) / (s.speed * 1000000) * 100 AS utilization FROM (SELECT idx, ts, value, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(ts) AS ts_ms, lagInFrame(value) OVER w AS prev, lagInFrame(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(ts)) OVER w AS prev_ms, row_number() OVER w AS rn FROM snmp.metrics WHERE device = '${device}' AND metric = 'ifHCOutOctets' AND $__timeFilter(ts) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY idx ORDER BY ts)) AS r INNER JOIN (SELECT idx, argMax(value, ts) AS speed FROM snmp.metrics WHERE device = '${device}' AND metric = 'ifHighSpeed' GROUP BY idx HAVING speed > 0) AS s ON s.idx = r.idx LEFT JOIN (SELECT idx, argMax(value, ts) AS name FROM snmp.info WHERE device = '${device}' AND metric = 'ifDescr' GROUP BY idx) AS n ON n.idx = r.idx WHERE r.rn > 1 AND r.value >= r.prev AND r.ts_ms > r.prev_ms ORDER BY time

SELECT m.ts AS time, d.name AS component, m.value AS cpu FROM snmp.metrics AS m INNER JOIN (SELECT idx, argMax(value, ts) AS name FROM snmp.info WHERE device = '${device}' AND metric = 'jnxOperatingDescr' GROUP BY idx) AS d ON d.idx = m.idx WHERE m.device = '${device}' AND m.metric = 'jnxOperatingCPU' AND $__timeFilter(m.ts) ORDER BY time

SELECT m.ts AS time, d.name AS component, m.value AS memory FROM snmp.metrics AS m INNER JOIN (SELECT idx, argMax(value, ts) AS name FROM snmp.info WHERE device = '${device}' AND metric = 'jnxOperatingDescr' GROUP BY idx) AS d ON d.idx = m.idx WHERE m.device = '${device}' AND m.metric = 'jnxOperatingBuffer' AND $__timeFilter(m.ts) ORDER BY time

SELECT m.ts AS time, d.name AS component, m.value AS temperature FROM snmp.metrics AS m INNER JOIN (SELECT idx, argMax(value, ts) AS name FROM snmp.info WHERE device = '${device}' AND metric = 'jnxOperatingDescr' GROUP BY idx) AS d ON d.idx = m.idx WHERE m.device = '${device}' AND m.metric = 'jnxOperatingTemp' AND $__timeFilter(m.ts) ORDER BY time

SELECT toUInt32OrZero(i.idx) AS ifIndex, i.name, i.alias, m.admin, m.oper, m.speed_mbps, m.mtu, i.mac FROM (SELECT idx, anyIf(v, metric = 'ifDescr') AS name, anyIf(v, metric = 'ifAlias') AS alias, anyIf(v, metric = 'ifPhysAddress') AS mac FROM (SELECT idx, metric, argMax(value, ts) AS v FROM snmp.info WHERE device = '${device}' AND metric IN ('ifDescr', 'ifAlias', 'ifPhysAddress') GROUP BY idx, metric) GROUP BY idx) AS i LEFT JOIN (SELECT idx, multiIf(anyIf(v, metric = 'ifOperStatus') = 1, 'up', anyIf(v, metric = 'ifOperStatus') = 2, 'down', 'other') AS oper, if(anyIf(v, metric = 'ifAdminStatus') = 1, 'up', 'down') AS admin, anyIf(v, metric = 'ifHighSpeed') AS speed_mbps, anyIf(v, metric = 'ifMtu') AS mtu FROM (SELECT idx, metric, argMax(value, ts) AS v FROM snmp.metrics WHERE device = '${device}' AND metric IN ('ifOperStatus', 'ifAdminStatus', 'ifHighSpeed', 'ifMtu') GROUP BY idx, metric) GROUP BY idx) AS m ON m.idx = i.idx ORDER BY ifIndex

SELECT idx AS index, anyIf(v, metric = 'lldpRemSysName') AS neighbor, anyIf(v, metric = 'lldpRemPortId') AS port, anyIf(v, metric = 'lldpRemPortDesc') AS port_description FROM (SELECT idx, metric, argMax(value, ts) AS v FROM snmp.info WHERE device = '${device}' AND metric IN ('lldpRemSysName', 'lldpRemPortId', 'lldpRemPortDesc') GROUP BY idx, metric) GROUP BY idx ORDER BY idx

SELECT r.ts AS time, concat(r.metric, ' ', coalesce(n.name, r.idx)) AS series, (r.value - r.prev) / ((r.ts_ms - r.prev_ms) / 1000) AS pps FROM (SELECT metric, idx, ts, value, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(ts) AS ts_ms, lagInFrame(value) OVER w AS prev, lagInFrame(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(ts)) OVER w AS prev_ms, row_number() OVER w AS rn FROM snmp.metrics WHERE device = '${device}' AND metric IN ('ifInErrors', 'ifOutErrors', 'ifInDiscards', 'ifOutDiscards') AND $__timeFilter(ts) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY metric, idx ORDER BY ts)) AS r LEFT JOIN (SELECT idx, argMax(value, ts) AS name FROM snmp.info WHERE device = '${device}' AND metric = 'ifDescr' GROUP BY idx) AS n ON n.idx = r.idx WHERE r.rn > 1 AND r.value > r.prev AND r.ts_ms > r.prev_ms ORDER BY time
